items.title: Xen Hypervisor Flaws Let One Malicious VM Read and Write Any Other VM's Memory
items.snippet: Two flaws in the Xen hypervisor allow a malicious guest virtual machine (VM) to read and write the memory of other VMs on the same host, including dom0. Dom0 is the VM that, by default, has full permissions and manages the others. Patches are out, and there is no known mitigation, the Xen Project said in an advisory on November 3. All Xen versions from 4.6 onward are vulnerable,
items.summary: Two flaws in the Xen hypervisor let a malicious guest VM read and write memory across other VMs on the same host. Cloud infrastructure operators and system administrators running Xen are affected. Apply the patches from the Xen Project.

items.title: Radio With No Radar: Why Agent Runtime Security Fails Without the Layers Beneath It
items.snippet: Nearly every agent security pitch now ends on the same promise: the product stops the bad action in real time. The promise holds for one kind of agent, the kind whose traffic passes through a gateway the enterprise owns. Most agents never touch one. One recent case shows what that gap looks like in practice. An employee asked an AI assistant to trigger a mass-email automation. The automation
items.summary: AI agent runtime security often fails because most agents never pass through an enterprise-owned gateway. Developers building autonomous AI agents and MCP workflows are affected. Review and implement comprehensive multi-layer security controls beyond runtime traffic gateways.

odf-kit: HTML injection leading to XSS in odtToHtml() and odsToHtml() via unescaped style attribute values
items.snippet: ODF style attribute values are interpolated into `style="..."` attributes without HTML-escaping in both of odf-kit's to-HTML renderers (`odtToHtml` and `odsToHtml`). A double-quote character inside an attacker-controlled style value breaks out of the attribute, allowing arbitrary HTML/attribute injection — and therefore script execution (XSS) — from a crafted `.odt` or `.ods` file wherever the re…
items.summary: The odf-kit package contains an HTML injection vulnerability in its to-HTML renderers due to unescaped style attributes. Upgrade odf-kit to 0.14.2 or later.

The attacker's code then runs as root, according to advisories that Debian, Ubuntu, and APT's developers published on November 4. items.summary: A vulnerability in Debian and Ubuntu's APT package manager allows MitM attackers to swap verified packages and execute code as root. Upgrade APT to the latest patched version provided by your distribution.

items.title: Researchers Uncover Prompt Adware Hidden in OpenAI Codex Jailbreak Toolkit

items.summary: An OpenAI Codex jailbreak bundle contains prompt adware designed to hijack AI agent instructions and inject third-party ads. Review and sanitize external jailbreak toolkits or bundles before use in agentic workflows.
